generation_target.rule: BPM, key and target duration are generation targets, not metadata for the edit reference.

edit_reference.rule: Preserve the frozen reference lineage. Do not inherit generation-target BPM, key or target duration.

tests.name: Full song generation
tests.task: Generate a complete song from the frozen generation-target lyric, BPM, key, structure and style brief.

tests.name: Section replacement
tests.task: Replace only the selected verse while preserving every unselected region.

tests.name: Lyric correction in place
tests.task: Change one lyric line without rebuilding the instrumental or neighboring vocal phrasing.

tests.name: Vocal identity preservation
tests.task: Regenerate a vocal phrase while preserving the frozen reference vocal identity.

tests.name: PT-BR prosody
tests.task: Sing the frozen Brazilian Portuguese generation-target passage naturally, preserving stress, contractions and colloquial flow.

tests.name: Pitch and note correction
tests.task: Correct pitch and target notes in the frozen reference without robotic timbre or loss of expressive detail.

tests.name: Harmony generation
tests.task: Generate discreet high and low harmonies aligned to the frozen reference lead vocal.

tests.name: Arrangement change
tests.task: Change arrangement characteristics while preserving melody, lyric, vocal identity and song form of the frozen reference.

tests.name: Stem separation and reconstruction
tests.task: Separate frozen-reference stems and reconstruct the mix with minimal leakage and phase damage.

tests.name: Conversational edit execution
tests.task: Execute a frozen natural-language edit request against the reference correctly without requiring technical DAW terminology.

tests.name: Continuity under repeated edits
tests.task: Apply three sequential local edits to the frozen reference while preserving the global identity of the song.

tests.name: Export integrity
tests.task: Export frozen-reference master and stems with correct duration, sample format, channel layout and no added truncation or clipping.
